name: Five-Foot-Way Cobbler Repair Stand
description: Original static exhibit inspired by Singapore five-foot-way cobblers, with a mounted cast shoe last, a loose sole with genuine raised tread, and a small parked mallet.
summary: Original low wooden workstand with a true socket-mounted shoe last and physically treaded sole.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: Original shaped solid last, open prismatic socket, fitted post and relief tread; vertex colour and native Cycles studio preview.
rights: Original project asset; redistribution terms for public downloads are not specified.
accuracy_notes: Interpretive static trade exhibit; not a named artifact, repair tool specification or operating guide. Blender -Y front/+Z up, glTF +Z front/+Y up.

attribution.credit: All geometry, materials, original tread pattern and studio render authored for the Gallery.
